zh: 模数为 p 的位置只能产生 0..p−1 中的值；模数越小，可选集合越小，而且小模数的可选集合包含在大模数的可选集合里。
按模数从小到大处理，并始终让已经产生的不同值是最紧凑的 0..count−1：如果当前模数 > count，就让它产生新值 count；否则它能产生的值全都已经用过，只能重复。
把模数升序排序，count 从 0 开始；对每个模数 p，若 p > count 则 count 加一；最后输出 count。
en: A position with modulus p can only produce values in 0..p-1; a smaller modulus has a smaller set of options, and the options of a small modulus are contained in those of a larger one.

Process the moduli from small to large and keep the distinct values produced so far as compact as possible, namely 0..count-1: if the current modulus is greater than count, let it produce the new value count; otherwise every value it can produce is already used, so it can only repeat one.
Sort the moduli ascending and start with count = 0; for each modulus p, increase count when p > count; print count at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Process the moduli in ascending order with 0..count-1 already constructed. If the modulus is greater than count, give the current position the new remainder count and increase the counter.

## Proof of correctness

The usable sets of smaller moduli are nested inside those of larger moduli. If the current modulus is <= count, all its usable values already lie in 0..count-1, so it cannot add a new distinct value; otherwise the new value count is feasible. This most compact set of distinct values is the least restrictive for later constraints, and induction shows it is optimal.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
